item.title: Pierce Manufacturing Appoints Marty Bass as President
item.description: Marty Bass has been appointed President of Pierce Manufacturing, bringing more than 20 years of leadership in global manufacturing to enhance quality and operational excellence amid industry challenges. item.title: Veteran Firefighter Drowns in Ice Tragedy at NJ Waterfront Marina
item.description: A veteran firefighter in South Jersey died after falling through ice at Wiggins Park Marina. He was submerged for several minutes before being pronounced dead at the hospital.
